items.notes:
Dexterity saving throw DC 18, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the behir (the behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time). On a failed save The behir swallows the target, which is no longer Grappled. While swallowed, a creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, and takes 21 (6d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns.

If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 10 feet of the behir and has the Prone condition. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

items.name: Eye Rays
items.notes:
The beholder randomly shoots one of the following magical rays at a target it can see within 120 feet of itself (roll 1d10; reroll if the beholder has already used that ray during this turn):

1: Charm Ray — Wisdom saving throw DC 16. On a failed save, 13 (3d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition for 1 hour or until it takes damage. On a successful save, Half damage only.

2: Paralyzing Ray — Constitution saving throw DC 16. On a failed save, The target has the Paralyzed condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

3: Fear Ray — Wisdom saving throw DC 16. On a failed save, 14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, Half damage only.

4: Slowing Ray — Constitution saving throw DC 16. On a failed save, 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage. Until the end of the target's next turn, the target's Speed is halved; the target can't take Reactions; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. On a successful save, Half damage only.

5: Enervation Ray — Constitution saving throw DC 16. On a failed save, 13 (3d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points. On a successful save, Half damage only.

6: Telekinetic Ray — Strength saving throw DC 16 (the target succeeds automatically if it is Gargantuan). On a failed save, The beholder moves the target up to 30 feet in any direction. The target has the Restrained condition until the start of the beholder's next turn or until the beholder has the Incapacitated condition. The beholder can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a tool or opening a door or container.

7: Sleep Ray — Wisdom saving throw DC 16 (the target succeeds automatically if it is a Construct or an Undead). On a failed save, The target has the Unconscious condition for 1 minute. The condition ends if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

8: Petrification Ray — Constitution saving throw DC 16. On a failed save The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a failed save The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.

9: Disintegration Ray — Dexterity saving throw DC 16. On a failed save, 36 (8d8) Force damage. If the target is a nonmagical object or a creation of magical force, a 10-foot Cube of it disintegrates into dust. On a successful save, Half damage. On a successful save, If the target is a creature and this damage reduces it to 0 Hit Points, it disintegrates into dust.

10: Death Ray — Dexterity saving throw DC 16. On a failed save, 55 (10d10) Necrotic damage. On a successful save, Half damage. On a successful save, The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 Hit Points.

items.name: Fear Ray
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 14. On a failed save, 13 (3d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Enervation Ray

items.name: Disintegration Ray
items.notes: Dexterity saving throw DC 14. On a failed save, 27 (5d10) Force damage. If the target is a nonmagical object or a creation of magical force, a 10-foot Cube of it disintegrates into dust. On a successful save, half damage. On a successful save or failed save: If the target is a creature and this damage reduces it to 0 Hit Points, it disintegrates into dust.

items.name: Undead Fortitude
items.notes: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

items.name: Frenzied Rush
items.notes: Each ally within 30 feet of the berserker can take a Reaction to move up to half the ally's Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. The berserker can also move up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

items.name: Split
items.notes: While the pudding is Large or Medium and has 10+ Hit Points, it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. The pudding splits into two new Black Puddings. Each new pudding is one size smaller than the original pudding and acts on its Initiative. The original pudding's Hit Points are divided evenly between the new puddings (round down).

items.name: Amorphous
items.notes: The pudding can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

items.name: Corrosive Form
items.notes:
A creature that hits the pudding with a melee attack roll takes 4 (1d8) Acid damage. Nonmagical ammunition is destroyed immediately after hitting the pudding and dealing any damage. Any nonmagical weapon takes a cumulative -1 penalty to attack rolls immediately after dealing damage to the pudding and coming into contact with it. The weapon is destroyed if the penalty reaches -5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the weapon.
In 1 minute, the pudding can eat through 2 feet of nonmagical wood or metal.

items.name: Spider Climb
items.notes: The pudding can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

items.name: Teleport
items.notes: The dog teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The blob makes two Pseudopod attacks and uses Engulf. It can replace one attack with a use of Restraining Glob.

items.name: Pseudopod
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +15 to hit, reach 30 ft. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) Force damage.

items.name: Engulf
items.notes:
The blob moves up to its Speed and can move through the spaces of Huge or smaller creatures and objects. Strength saving throw DC 23, each creature or object whose space the blob enters for the first time during this move. On a failed save, The target is engulfed. While engulfed, a target has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the blob, and when the blob moves, the engulfed target moves with it. A nonmagical object is destroyed after spending 1 minute engulfed.

While engulfed, a creature takes 21 (6d6) Force damage at the start of each of its turns, is suffocating, has the Restrained condition, and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save The target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.

items.name: Restraining Glob
items.notes: The blob lobs a slimy glob at one Large or smaller creature it can see within 600 feet of itself. Dexterity saving throw DC 23, the targeted creature. On a failed save 18 (3d6 + 8) Acid damage. The glob rolls the target 60 feet straight toward the blob, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn, when the glob harmlessly dissolves. On a successful save Half damage only.

items.name: Astral Implosion
items.notes: If the blob is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it implodes and ejects any creatures and objects engulfed by it into the Astral Sea. The blob itself vanishes, leaving behind a layer of slime on everything that was within 600 feet of it. In 1d20 years, the blob reconstitutes on a random world in the Material Plane.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If the blob fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The blob has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Decay
items.notes: The blob deals 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage to each creature engulfed by it. The blob can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Grasping Glob
items.notes: The blob uses Restraining Glob. The blob can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Lashing Goop
items.notes: The blob makes one Pseudopod attack.

items.name: Beak
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage if the target is Bloodied.

items.name: Pack Tactics
items.notes: The hawk has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hawk's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

items.name: Mutating Claw
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage. If the target is a Humanoid not cursed by a slaad, it is subjected to the following effect. Dexterity saving throw Constitution saving throw. DC 15. On a failed save, The target is cursed. The cursed target can't regain Hit Points, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) after every 24 hours and doesn't return to normal after finishing a Long Rest. If the curse reduces the target's Hit Point maximum to 0, the curse ends, and instead of dying, the target instantly transforms into a Red Slaad or, if it can cast spells of level 3 or higher, a Green Slaad. Only a Wish spell can reverse this transformation.

items.name: Magic Resistance

items.name: Regeneration

A creature can take an action to try to detach the darkmantle from itself, doing so with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement.

items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 feet. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

items.name: Avoidance
items.notes: If the displacer beast is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

items.name: Displacement
items.notes: Attack rolls against the displacer beast have Disadvantage, since it projects an illusion that makes it appear to be near its actual location. This trait is suppressed while the displacer beast has the Incapacitated condition.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The djinni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

spells.name: create food and water
spells.note: can create wine instead of water

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The djinni makes three attacks, using Storm Blade or Storm Bolt in any combination.

items.name: Storm Blade
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 feet. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage.

items.name: Storm Bolt
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 feet. Hit: 13 (3d8) Thunder damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

items.name: Create Whirlwind
items.notes:
The djinni conjures a whirlwind at a point it can see within 120 feet. The whirlwind fills a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high Cylinder centered on that point. The whirlwind lasts until the djinni's Concentration on it ends. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 20 feet at the start of each of its turns.

Whenever the whirlwind enters a creature's space or a creature enters the whirlwind, that creature is subjected to the following effect. Strength saving throw DC 17 (a creature makes this save only once per turn, and the djinni is unaffected). On a failed save, While in the whirlwind, the target has the Restrained condition and moves with the whirlwind. At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained target takes 21 (6d6) Thunder damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Elemental Restoration
items.notes: If the djinni dies outside the Elemental Plane of Air, its body dissolves into mist, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Air.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The djinni has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Wishes
items.notes: The djinni has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the djinni knows it, the djinni can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the djinni can understand. If the djinni casts the spell for the creature, the djinni suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the djinni has cast it three times, the djinni can't do so again for 365 days.

spellcasting.name: Read Thoughts
spellcasting.notes: The doppelganger casts Detect Thoughts, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12).

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The doppelganger makes two Slam attacks and uses Unsettling Visage if available.

items.name: Slam
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6 (with Advantage during the first round of each combat), reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Unsettling Visage
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the doppelganger that can see the doppelganger. On a failed save, The target has the Frightened condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

items.name: Shape-Shift
items.notes: The doppelganger shape-shifts into a Medium or Small Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The dracolich casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The dracolich makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Ray of Sickness (level 2 version).

items.name: Rend
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

items.name: Necrotic Breath
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 20, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. On a failed save, 52 (8d12) Necrotic damage. On a successful save, Half damage.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If the dracolich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Life Suppression
items.notes: Creatures within 60 feet of the dracolich can't regain Hit Points.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The dracolich has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Soul Gem
items.notes:
The dracolich has a magical gem. If the dracolich is destroyed while the gem is on the same plane of existence as it, the dracolich gains a new body in 1d20 days, regaining all its Hit Points and appearing within 5 feet of the gem.

The gem is a Tiny object that has AC 20; HP 50; and Immunity to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage. The gem regains all its Hit Points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points. If the gem is destroyed, the dracolich can create a new one by completing an 8-hour ritual using a gem worth 1,000+ GP and by expending 5,000 GP, which the ritual consumes.

items.name: Pounce
items.notes: The dracolich moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

items.name: Sickening Ray
items.notes: The dracolich uses Spellcasting to cast Ray of Sickness (level 2 version). The dracolich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Terrifying Presence
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the dracolich. On a failed save 11 (2d10) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, The dracolich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

regional_effects.header:
The region containing a dracolich's lair is warped by its presence, creating the following effects:

If the dracolich is destroyed or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately. The effects resume if the dracolich gains a new body (see its Soul Gem trait).

items.name: Sapping Mist
items.notes: The area within 1 mile of the lair is Lightly Obscured by pale fog. Whenever a creature other than the dracolich or one of its allies finishes a Long Rest in that area, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 Exhaustion level.

items.name: Soul Drain
items.notes: Creatures within 1 mile of the lair have Disadvantage on Death Saving Throws.

items.name: Hooves
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The dragon makes three Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tail attack.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 15 ft. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Being underwater doesn't grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

items.name: Tail
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 15 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

items.name: Steam Breath
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 19, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. On a failed save, 56 (16d6) Fire damage. On a successful save, Half damage. On a successful save, Being underwater doesn't grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

items.name: Amphibious
items.notes: The dragon can breathe air and water.

name: Dretch
languages: Abyssal; telepathy 60 ft. (works only with creatures that understand Abyssal)

items.name: Rend
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.

items.name: Fetid Cloud
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 11, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the dretch. On a failed save, The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned, the creature can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both, and it can't take Reactions.

spellcasting.name: Magic of the Spider Queen (Recharge 5)
spellcasting.notes: The drider casts Darkness, Faerie Fire, or Web, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (DC 14).

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The drider makes three attacks, using Foreleg or Poison Burst in any combination.

items.name: Foreleg
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

items.name: Poison Burst
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 120 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Poison damage.

items.name: Spider Climb
items.notes: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

items.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
items.notes: While in sunlight, the drider has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

items.name: Web Walker
items.notes: The drider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the drider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The druid casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The druid makes two attacks, using Vine Staff or Verdant Wisp in any combination.

items.name: Vine Staff
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

items.name: Verdant Wisp
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 90 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) Radiant damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The dryad casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (DC 14):

spells.name: charm monster
spells.note: lasts 24 hours; ends early if the dryad casts the spell again

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The dryad makes one Vine Lash or Thorn Burst attack, and it can use Spellcasting to cast Charm Monster.

items.name: Vine Lash
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

items.name: Thorn Burst
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

items.name: Tree Stride
items.notes: If within 5 feet of a Large or bigger tree, the dryad teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a second Large or bigger tree that is within 60 feet of the previous tree.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The dryad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
items.notes: The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

spellcasting.name: Sleep (1/Day)
spellcasting.notes: The mephit casts the Sleep spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 10).

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

items.name: Blinding Breath
items.notes: Dexterity saving throw DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. On a failed save, The target has the Blinded condition until the end of the mephit's next turn.

items.name: Death Burst
items.notes: Dexterity saving throw DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. On a failed save 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage. On a successful save Half damage.

items.name: Talons
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 feet. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The elemental makes two attacks, using Slam or Rock Launch in any combination.

items.name: Slam
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Rock Launch
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 60 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

items.name: Earth Glide
items.notes: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

items.name: Siege Monster
items.notes: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The efreeti casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The efreeti makes three attacks, using Heated Blade or Hurl Flame in any combination.

items.name: Heated Blade
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 13 (2d12) Fire damage.

items.name: Hurl Flame
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 120 ft. Hit: 24 (7d6) Fire damage.

items.name: Elemental Restoration
items.notes: If the efreeti dies outside the Elemental Plane of Fire, its body dissolves into ash, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Fire.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The efreeti has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Wishes
items.notes: The efreeti has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the efreeti knows it, the efreeti can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the efreeti can understand. If the efreeti casts the spell for the creature, the efreeti suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the efreeti has cast it three times, the efreeti can't do so again for 365 days.

spellcasting.name: Control Weather
spellcasting.notes: The cataclysm casts the Control Weather spell, requiring no spell components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The cataclysm makes two Elemental Burst attacks.

items.name: Elemental Burst
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +15 to hit, reach 30 ft. or range 150 ft. Hit: 25 (5d6 + 8) damage of a type chosen by the cataclysm: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.

items.name: Cataclysmic Event
items.notes: The cataclysm creates one of the following effects at random (roll 1d4):

items.name: 1: Clinging Flames
items.notes: Dexterity saving throw DC 23, each creature in a 60-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the cataclysm can see within 150 feet. On a failed save, 45 (13d6) Fire damage. On a successful save Half damage. On a successful save, the target starts burning.

items.name: 2: Freezing Waves
items.notes: Strength saving throw DC 23, each creature in a 90-foot Cone. On a failed save, 22 (5d8) Bludgeoning damage plus 22 (5d8) Cold damage, and the target has the Prone condition. On a successful save Half damage only. On a successful save, the target's Speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

items.name: 3: Raging Storm
items.notes: A storm cloud fills a 60-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the cataclysm can see within 150 feet. The cloud lasts for 1 minute or until the cataclysm uses Cataclysmic Event again. Creatures entirely in the cloud have the Blinded and Deafened conditions and can't cast spells with a Verbal component. Dexterity saving throw DC 23, each creature that enters the cloud for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there. On a failed save, 18 (4d8) Lightning damage plus 18 (4d8) Thunder damage. On a successful save Half damage.

items.name: 4: Swallowing Earth
items.notes: Strength saving throw DC 23, each creature in a 90-foot Cube originating from a point on the ground within 150 feet. On a failed save, 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Acid damage, and the target has the Prone condition and is buried under rubble. A buried target has the Restrained condition, has Total Cover, and is suffocating. As an action, a buried creature or another creature within 5 feet of it can make a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the creature is no longer buried. On a successful save Half damage only.

items.name: Earth Glide
items.notes: The cataclysm can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the cataclysm doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If the cataclysm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Siege Monster
items.notes: The cataclysm deals double damage to objects and structures.

items.name: Eruption
items.notes: The cataclysm makes one Elemental Burst attack.

items.name: Rumbling Movement
items.notes: The cataclysm moves up to its Speed, Fly Speed, or Swim Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature within 5 feet of the cataclysm as it moves is targeted once by the following effect. Constitution saving throw DC 23. On a failed save, the target has the Prone condition. On a successful save, the cataclysm can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The cultist makes three attacks, using Elemental Flail or Elemental Claw in any combination.

items.name: Elemental Flail
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) damage of a type chosen by the cultist: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.

items.name: Elemental Claw
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) damage of a type chosen by the cultist: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the cultist moves the target up to 10 feet straight toward or away from itself.

items.name: Elemental Absorption
items.notes: The cultist takes Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage. The cultist gives itself Resistance to that instance of damage and gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The elephant makes two Gore attacks.

items.name: Gore
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the elephant moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.

items.name: Trample
items.notes: Dexterity saving throw DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. On a failed save, 17 (2d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. On a successful save, Half damage.

items.name: Ram
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the elk moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The empyrean casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 23):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The empyrean makes two attacks, using Sacred Weapon or Divine Ray in any combination.

items.name: Sacred Weapon
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +17, reach 10 ft. Hit: 31 (6d6 + 10) Force damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the empyrean's next turn. The target can choose not to be Stunned, in which case it takes an extra 21 Force damage that bypasses Resistance or Immunity.

items.name: Divine Ray
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +15, range 600 ft. Hit: 35 (6d8 + 8) Necrotic or Radiant damage (empyrean's choice).

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If the empyrean fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The empyrean has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Bolster
items.notes: The empyrean gains 10 Temporary Hit Points, and the empyrean and each ally within 30 feet of it gain Advantage on D20 Tests until the end of the empyrean's next turn. The empyrean can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Shockwave of Glory
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 23, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the empyrean. On a failed save 27 (6d8) Force damage, and the target has the Prone condition. On a successful save Half damage only. On a successful save The empyrean can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Smite
items.notes: The empyrean makes one Divine Ray attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The empyrean casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability:

spellcasting.name: Healing Word (1/Day)
spellcasting.notes: The empyrean casts Healing Word, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

items.name: Otherworldly Strike
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Necrotic or Radiant damage (empyrean's choice).

items.name: Incorporeal Movement
items.notes: The empyrean can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The empyrean has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The erinyes makes three Withering Sword attacks and can use Entangling Rope.

items.name: Withering Sword
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.

items.name: Entangling Rope (Requires Magic Rope)
items.notes: Strength saving throw DC 16, one creature the erinyes can see within 120 feet. On a failed save, 14 (4d6) Force damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the rope is destroyed, the erinyes uses a Bonus Action to release the target, or the erinyes uses Entangling Rope again.

items.name: Parry
items.notes: The erinyes is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. The erinyes adds 4 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

items.name: Diabolical Restoration
items.notes: If the erinyes dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The erinyes has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Magic Rope
items.notes: The erinyes has a magic rope. While bearing it, the erinyes can use the Entangling Rope action. The rope has AC 20, HP 90, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The rope turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points, if it is 5+ feet away from the erinyes for 1 hour or more, or if the erinyes dies. If the rope is damaged or destroyed, the erinyes can fully restore it when finishing a Short Rest or Long Rest.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The ettercap makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the ettercap's next turn.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

items.name: Web Strand
items.notes: Dexterity saving throw DC 12, one Large or smaller creature the ettercap can see within 30 feet. On a failed save, The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage).

items.name: Reel
items.notes: The ettercap pulls one creature within 30 feet of itself that is Restrained by its Web Strand up to 25 feet straight toward itself.

items.name: Spider Climb
items.notes: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

items.name: Web Walker
items.notes: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the ettercap knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The ettin makes one Battleaxe attack and one Morningstar attack.

items.name: Battleaxe
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

items.name: Morningstar
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

spellcasting.name: Superior Invisibility
spellcasting.notes: The dragon casts Greater Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Psychic damage.

items.name: Euphoria Breath
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. On a failed save, The target has the Incapacitated condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While Incapacitated, the target uses all its movement on each of its turns to move in a random direction.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The dragon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (DC 12):

spellcasting.name: Superior Invisibility
spellcasting.notes: The dragon casts Greater Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Psychic damage.

items.name: Euphoria Breath
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. On a failed save, the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn and uses all its movement on its turn to move in a random direction.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The dragon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks):

spellcasting.name: Hellish Rebuke
spellcasting.notes: The cultist casts Hellish Rebuke in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The cultist makes three Pact Axe attacks.

items.name: Pact Axe
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Fire damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The elemental makes two Burn attacks.

items.name: Burn
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it starts burning.

items.name: Fire Aura
items.notes: At the end of each of the elemental's turns, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the elemental takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage. Creatures and flammable objects in the Emanation start burning.

items.name: Fire Form
items.notes: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

items.name: Illumination

items.name: Luring Song
items.notes: The harpy sings a magical melody, which lasts until the harpy's Concentration ends on it. Wisdom saving throw DC 11, each Humanoid and Giant in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the harpy when the song starts. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition until the song ends and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. While Charmed, the target has the Incapacitated condition and ignores the Luring Song of other harpies. If the target is more than 5 feet from the harpy, the target moves on its turn toward the harpy by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the harpy. It doesn't avoid Opportunity Attacks; however, before moving into damaging terrain (such as lava or a pit) and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the harpy, the target repeats the save. On a successful save, the target is immune to this harpy's Luring Song for 24 hours.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The revenant makes two Object Slam attacks and uses Invitation.

items.name: Object Slam
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9 (with Advantage if the target is inside the revenant's space), reach 10 ft. or range 30/90 ft. Hit: 27 (5d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Invitation
items.notes: Charisma saving throw DC 17, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. On a failed save, The target is teleported inside the revenant's space and swallowed. A swallowed creature has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the revenant. While the revenant has Hit Points, a swallowed creature can leave the revenant's space only by using magic that enables planar travel, such as the Plane Shift spell.

items.name: Haunted Zone
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 17, any creature that casts a spell while inside the revenant's space. On a failed save, The spell fails and is wasted.

items.name: Undead Restoration
items.notes: If the revenant dies, it revives 24 hours later unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on its remains. If it revives, it animates another Gargantuan object or structure elsewhere on the same plane of existence; it now looks different but uses the same stat block and returns with all its Hit Points.

items.name: Talons
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Slashing damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The hound makes two Bite attacks.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

items.name: Fire Breath
items.notes: Dexterity saving throw DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. On a failed save, 17 (5d6) Fire damage. On a successful save, Half damage.

items.name: Pack Tactics
items.notes: The hound has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

name: Helmed Horror
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

items.notes: The helmed horror makes two Arcane Sword attacks.

items.name: Arcane Sword
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) Force damage.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The helmed horror has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Spell Immunity
items.notes: The helmed horror is immune to three spells chosen by its creator. Typical choices include Heat Metal, Lightning Bolt, and Magic Missile.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The hezrou makes three Rend attacks.

items.name: Rend
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage.

items.name: Leap
items.notes: The hezrou jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

items.name: Demonic Restoration
items.notes: If the hezrou dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The hezrou has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Stench
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 16, any creature that starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the hezrou. On a failed save, The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The giant makes two attacks, using Tree Club or Trash Lob in any combination.

items.name: Tree Club
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

items.name: Trash Lob
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

items.notes: The hippogriff makes two Rend attacks.

items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

items.name: Flyby
items.notes: The hippogriff doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Piercing damage.

items.name: Hold Breath
items.notes: The hippopotamus can hold its breath for 10 minutes.

name: Homunculus
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. Constitution saving throw DC 12. On a failed save, the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the homunculus's next turn. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. While Poisoned, the target has the Unconscious condition, which ends early if the target takes any damage.

items.name: Telepathic Bond
items.notes: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, the two of them can communicate telepathically with each other.

items.notes: The hook horror makes two Hook attacks.

items.name: Hook
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the hook horror moves the target 5 feet straight toward or away from itself.

items.name: Searing Fork
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Fire damage.

items.name: Hurl Flame
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +8 to hit, range 150 ft. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) Fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.

items.name: Infernal Tail
items.notes: Dexterity saving throw DC 17, one creature the devil can see within 10 feet. On a failed save, 10 (1d8 + 6) Necrotic damage, and the target receives an infernal wound if it doesn't have one. While wounded, the target loses 10 (3d6) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a DC 17 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

items.name: Diabolical Restoration
items.notes: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6 (with Advantage if the target doesn't have all its Hit Points), reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

items.name: Water Breathing
items.notes: The shark can breathe only underwater.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The hydra makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Piercing damage.

items.name: Hold Breath
items.notes: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

items.name: Multiple Heads
items.notes: The hydra has five heads. Whenever the hydra takes 25 damage or more on a single turn, one of its heads dies. The hydra dies if all its heads are dead. At the end of each of its turns when it has at least one living head, the hydra grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken Fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 20 Hit Points when it grows new heads.

items.name: Reactive Heads
items.notes: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra Reaction that can be used only for Opportunity Attacks.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d6) Piercing damage.

items.name: Pack Tactics
items.notes: The hyena has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hyena's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

spellcasting.name: Ice Wall {@recharge}
spellcasting.notes: The devil casts Wall of Ice (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The devil makes three Ice Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tail attack.

items.name: Ice Spear
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Cold damage. Until the end of its next turn, the target can't take a Bonus Action or Reaction, its Speed decreases by 10 feet, and it can move or take one action on its turn, not both. The spear magically returns to the devil's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

items.name: Tail
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Cold damage.

items.name: Diabolical Restoration
items.notes: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Fog Cloud (1/Day)
spellcasting.notes: The mephit casts Fog Cloud, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.

items.name: Frost Breath
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. On a failed save, 7 (3d4) Cold damage. On a successful save, Half damage.

items.name: Death Burst
items.notes: The mephit explodes when it dies. Constitution saving throw DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. On a failed save, 5 (2d4) Cold damage. On a successful save, Half damage.

spellcasting.name: Invisibility
spellcasting.notes: The imp casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

items.name: Sting
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

items.name: Shape-Shift
items.notes: The imp shape-shifts to resemble a rat (Speed 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., Fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., Climb 20 ft.), or it returns to its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for its Speed. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The imp has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The incubus casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The incubus makes two Restless Touch attacks.

items.name: Restless Touch
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target is cursed for 24 hours or until the incubus dies. Until the curse ends, the target gains no benefit from finishing Short Rests.

items.name: Nightmare
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 15, one creature the incubus can see within 60 feet. On a failed save, If the target has 20 Hit Points or fewer, it has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour, until it takes damage, or until a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. Otherwise, the target takes 18 (4d8) Psychic damage.

items.name: Succubus Form
items.notes: When the incubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into a Succubus, using that stat block instead of this one. Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

name: Intellect Devourer
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak; telepathy 60 ft.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The intellect devourer makes one Claw attack and uses Devour Intellect.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

items.name: Devour Intellect
items.notes: Intelligence saving throw DC 12, one creature the intellect devourer can see within 5 feet. On a failed save, 11 (2d10) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of the intellect devourer's next turn.

items.name: Steal Body
items.notes:
Intelligence saving throw DC 12, one Small or Medium creature within 5 feet that has the Incapacitated condition, is a Humanoid or Beast, and has 10 Hit Points or fewer. On a failed save, the intellect devourer possesses the target, consumes its brain, and teleports inside its skull. While there, the intellect devourer has Total Cover against attacks and other effects originating outside its host. The intellect devourer retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; its understanding of Deep Speech; its telepathy; and its Detect Intelligence trait. It otherwise adopts the target's game statistics. It knows everything the target knew, including spells and languages.

If the host body dies, the intellect devourer must leave it. The intellect devourer is also forced out if the target regains its devoured brain by means of a Wish spell. By spending 5 feet of its movement, the intellect devourer can voluntarily leave the body, teleporting to the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. The body then dies unless its brain is restored before the end of the intellect devourer's next turn.

items.name: Detect Intelligence
items.notes: The intellect devourer magically senses the location of any creature within 300 feet of itself that has an Intelligence score of 3 or higher, regardless of interposing barriers.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The stalker makes three Wind Swipe attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Vortex.

items.name: Wind Swipe
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Force damage.

items.name: Vortex
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 14, one Large or smaller creature in the stalker's space. On a failed save, 7 (1d8 + 3) Thunder damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, the target can't cast spells with a Verbal component and takes 7 (2d6) Thunder damage at the start of each of the stalker's turns.

items.name: Air Form
items.notes: The stalker can enter an enemy's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

items.name: Invisibility
items.notes: The stalker has the Invisible condition.

name: Iron Golem
languages: understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The golem makes two attacks, using Bladed Arm or Fiery Bolt in any combination.

items.name: Bladed Arm
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

items.name: Fiery Bolt
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 120 ft. Hit: 36 (8d8) Fire damage.

items.name: Poison Breath
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. On a failed save, 55 (10d10) Poison damage. On a successful save, Half damage.

items.name: Fire Absorption
items.notes: Whenever the golem is subjected to Fire damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Fire damage dealt.

items.name: Immutable Form
items.notes: The golem can't shape-shift.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +1, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 (1d4 - 1) Piercing damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The jackalwere makes two Rend or Slam attacks.

items.name: Rend (Jackal or Hybrid Form Only)
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

items.name: Slam (Human or Hybrid Form Only)
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Sleep Gaze
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 10, one creature the jackalwere can see within 30 feet (Constructs and Undead succeed automatically). On a failed save, The target has the Unconscious condition for 10 minutes or until it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. On a successful save, The target is immune to this jackalwere's Sleep Gaze for 24 hours.

items.name: Shape-Shift
items.notes: The jackalwere shape-shifts into a Medium human or a Medium jackal-humanoid hybrid, or it returns to its true form (that of a Small jackal). Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

items.name: Pack Tactics
items.notes: The jackalwere has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the jackalwere's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

items.name: Rend
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.

items.name: Shadow Breath
items.notes: Dexterity saving throw DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. On a failed save, 17 (5d6) Necrotic damage. On a successful save, Half damage. On a successful save, A Humanoid reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage dies, and a Shadow rises from its corpse. The shadow is under the dragon's control and shares the dragon's Initiative count but acts immediately after the dragon.

items.name: Shadow Stealth
items.notes: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the dragon takes the Hide action.

items.name: Living Shadow
items.notes: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the dragon has Resistance to damage that isn't Force, Psychic, or Radiant.

items.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
items.notes: While in sunlight, the dragon has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

spellcasting.name: Eldritch Lantern
spellcasting.notes: The kenku casts Faerie Fire, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 10).

items.name: Shadow Blade
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Necrotic damage. The blade magically returns to the kenku's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

items.name: Mimicry
items.notes: The kenku can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

items.name: Hold Breath
items.notes: The whale can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The knight makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.

items.name: Greatsword
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage.

items.name: Heavy Crossbow
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +2, range 100/400 ft. Hit: 11 (2d10) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage.

items.name: Parry
items.notes: The knight is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. The knight adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

items.name: Pack Tactics
items.notes: The kobold has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

items.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
items.notes: While in sunlight, the kobold has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

name: Kraken
languages: and Primordial but can't speak; telepathy 120 ft.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The kraken makes two Tentacle attacks and uses Fling, Lightning Strike, or Swallow.

items.name: Tentacle
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +17, reach 30 ft. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20) from one of ten tentacles, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

items.name: Fling
items.notes: The kraken throws a Large or smaller creature Grappled by it to a space it can see within 60 feet of itself that isn't in the air. Dexterity saving throw DC 25, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. On a failed save, 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. On a successful save, Half damage only.

items.name: Lightning Strike
items.notes: Dexterity saving throw DC 23, one creature the kraken can see within 120 feet. On a failed save, 33 (6d10) Lightning damage. On a successful save, Half damage.

items.name: Swallow
items.notes:
Dexterity saving throw DC 25, one creature Grappled by the kraken (it can have up to four creatures swallowed at a time). On a failed save, 23 (3d8 + 10) Piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is swallowed and no longer Grappled. A swallowed creature has the Restrained condition, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and takes 24 (7d6) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

If the kraken takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the kraken with the Prone condition. If the kraken dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

items.name: Amphibious
items.notes: The kraken can breathe air and water.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Siege Monster
items.notes: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

items.name: Storm Bolt
items.notes: The kraken uses Lightning Strike.

items.name: Toxic Ink
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 23, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the kraken while it is underwater. On a failed save, The target has the Blinded and Poisoned conditions until the end of the kraken's next turn. The kraken then moves up to its Speed. On a successful save, The kraken can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

regional_effects.header:
The region containing a kraken's lair is twisted by its presence, creating the following effects:

If the kraken dies or moves its lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

items.name: Ocean Tyrant
items.notes: The kraken exerts its dominance over animals in its domain. All Beasts within 1 mile of the lair have the Charmed condition while in that area.

items.name: Sea and Storms
items.notes: While in its lair, the kraken can cast Control Weather, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

items.name: Spear
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

items.name: Sticky Net
items.notes: Dexterity saving throw DC 10, one Large or smaller creature the kuo-toa can see within 15 feet. On a failed save, the target has the Restrained condition until the net is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage). A creature can take an action to make a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check to free itself or another creature in a net within 5 feet, destroying the net on a success.

items.name: Sticky Shield
items.notes: A creature misses the kuo-toa with a melee attack roll using a weapon. The triggering creature must make a Strength saving throw DC 11. On a failed save, the attack's weapon sticks to the kuo-toa's shield. If the target doesn't let go of the weapon, the target has the Grappled condition while the weapon is stuck (escape DC 11). While stuck, the weapon can't be used. The target can take an action to make a DC 11 Strength (Athletics) check, freeing the weapon on a success.

items.name: Amphibious
items.notes: The kuo-toa can breathe air and water.

items.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
items.notes: While in sunlight, the kuo-toa has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The kuo-toa casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

spellcasting.name: Shield of Faith (2/Day)
spellcasting.notes: The kuo-toa casts Shield of Faith, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

items.notes: The kuo-toa makes three Strange Scepter attacks.

items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 20 (5d6 + 3) Lightning damage.

items.name: Swallow
items.notes:
Strength saving throw DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the worm (it can have up to three creatures swallowed at a time). On a failed save, the target is swallowed by the worm, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and takes 17 (5d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the worm and has the Prone condition. If the worm dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

Over 2d4 × 10 days, the egg gestates. In the final 24 hours, the cursed target feels unwell; its Speed is halved, and it has Disadvantage on D20 Tests. At the end of this time, the egg turns into a Slaad Tadpole, which chews out of the host and kills it.

While it has 0 Hit Points in mist form, it can't return to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it returns to its vampire form and has the Paralyzed condition until it regains any Hit Points, and it regains 1 Hit Point after spending 1 hour there.

items.name: Looming Shadows

items.name: Mists
items.notes: The area within 1 mile of the lair is Lightly Obscured by a persistent, creeping fog. The vampire and any creatures of its choice are unaffected by the fog.

items.notes: The familiar makes two Umbral Dagger attacks.

items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) Necrotic damage. If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack, the target becomes Stable but has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. While it has the Poisoned condition, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

items.name: Deathless Agility
items.notes: The familiar takes the Dash or Disengage action.

items.name: Vampiric Connection
items.notes: While the familiar and its vampire master are on the same plane of existence, the vampire can communicate with the familiar telepathically, and the vampire can perceive through the familiar's senses.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The vampire makes one Bite attack and one Shadow Strike attack.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

items.name: Shadow Strike
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) Cold damage.

items.name: Shadow Stealth
items.notes: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the vampire takes the Hide action.

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
items.notes: The vampire takes 10 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

items.notes: The vampire makes two Claw attacks and uses Bite.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two claws.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 14, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. On a failed save, 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Point equal to that amount.

items.name: Deathless Agility
items.notes: The vampire takes the Dash or Disengage action.

items.name: Spider Climb
items.notes: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

items.name: Vampire Weakness
items.notes:
The vampire has these weaknesses:
Forbiddance: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant.
Running Water: The vampire takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.
Stake to the Heart: The vampire is destroyed if a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire has the Incapacitated condition.
Sunlight: The vampire takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Shadow Escape
items.notes: If the vampire drops to 0 Hit Points outside its resting place, it teleports into its resting place unless it is in running water or sunlight. If it can't teleport, it is destroyed. Once inside its resting place, it has the Paralyzed condition for 1 hour, after which it regains 1 Hit Point.

While grafted, the target has the Restrained condition and Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws. When the necrohulk moves, the grafted target moves with it. If the target dies while grafted, its body is destroyed, and the necrohulk regains 10 Hit Points. The grafted target or a creature within 5 feet of the necrohulk can take an action to make a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the target is no longer grafted and moves to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the necrohulk.
